column1: # pr-size-bands.tsv: one machine-read size band per row, the single source of the PR size thresholds.
# max_lines  a PR with more changed lines (added plus deleted) than this is over the band; - = no line limit
# max_files  a PR with more changed files than this is over the band; - = no file limit
#            warn          worker-pr-open.sh prints SIZE-WARN and opens
#            refuse        worker-pr-open.sh prints SIZE-REFUSE, exits 1 and opens nothing
#            brief-refuse  read by gen-briefs only (slice P1); worker-pr-open.sh ignores it
# A PR inside the soft band's limits (150-800 lines, at most 20 files) is the target: nothing happens.
# The coderabbit row is CodeRabbit's own cap: past 300 files it skips the whole review.
